title: The Right Way to Learn Machine Learning Most People Don't
description:
Machine learning is one of the most rewarding skills you can learn right now — but only if you learn it the right way. The biggest trap is staying stuck in learning mode and never building anything.
You don't need a PhD. You don't need to understand every single paper. But you do need to actually solve problems — that's the hard part, and what most people skip.

Follow the roadmap and keep chipping away. It's absolutely worth it.

#techwithtim #machinelearning #softwareengineering #programming
